compared_scope: overlapping OBSERVED dates in the requested range 2016-01-01..2023-12-31
tolerance_rationale: Sohu reports 成交量 in 手 (x100 to shares) and 成交金额 in 万元 (x10000 to yuan); the published rounding of those units alone produces sub-unit noise. A mismatch is only recorded when the derived values differ by more than one source's smallest reported unit.
agreement_only_note: OHLC agreed EXACTLY on every compared date, including both mismatch dates. Only volume/amount differ on 2 dates.
interpretation: This is a cross-source agreement check, NOT a point-in-time check. Both sources are CURRENT_QUERY_ONLY: they prove what each vendor serves TODAY, not what was public at any historical cutoff. Agreement raises confidence in the UNIT CONVERSION and in the raw values; it does NOT upgrade either source's evidence_class.
